title: Rigetti Computing annual revenue
definition: Total GAAP revenues reported by Rigetti Computing, Inc. from quantum computing systems, cloud access, and development contracts.

sources.title: Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1: Rigetti Computing Reports Fourth Quarter and Full-Year 2025 Financial Results

points.evidence: Consolidated Statements of Operations, 'Total revenues', Year Ended December 31, 2024: $10,790 thousand ($10.8 million).
Full-Year 2025 Financial Highlights: 'Total revenues for the twelve months ended December 31, 2025 were $7.1 million' (Statement of Operations: $7,088 thousand).
